enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Adjust pillow. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stretch arms. Rub eyes. Turn off alarm clock. Swing legs over edge of bed. Stand up. Walk to bedroom door. Open door. Walk out of bedroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and cereal box. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Wipe table. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Lay clothes on bed. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Walk to desk. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Pack laptop. Zip bag. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Walk to door. Open door. Exit bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Get in car. Put on seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive to work. Park car. Turn off engine. Unlock seatbelt. Get out of car. Lock car. Walk to workplace entrance. Open door. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Put on lab coat. Check schedule. Review patient files. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update records. Walk to nurses station. Discuss with colleague. Answer phone. Take notes. Walk to another patient room. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment. Wash hands. Update charts. Attend team meeting. Present case. Return to workstation. Check emails. Reply to messages. Organize files. Prepare for next patient.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Carry tray to return. Throw away trash. Walk to break room. Sit on chair. Check phone. Scroll. Stand up. Walk back to workstation.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Return to workstation. Check messages. Respond to emails. Walk to patient room. Administer treatment. Assist doctor. Take notes. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Return to workstation. Enter patient data. Review test results. Consult with specialist. Update care plan. Walk to patient room. Explain procedure. Perform procedure. Monitor patient. Record observations. Walk to break room. Fill water bottle. Return to workstation. Complete paperwork. End shift.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Get in car. Put on seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive home. Park car. Turn off engine. Unlock seatbelt. Get out of car. Lock car. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot and pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate and utensils. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and utensils. Place in dishwasher. Wipe table. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

Pick up remaining dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Wipe stove. Clean sink. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch show. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Drink. Watch more TV. Change channels. Watch another show. Stand up. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Exit living room.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Remain still.
